timestamp_audit_conclusion: One verified canceled GDP schedule row386239 is excluded. All other primary US CPI/NFP/PCE/GDP release dates match official BLS/BEA sources. No malformed/out-of-window timestamps. UTC offsets correctly preserve US08:30 data releases, FOMC14:00/14:30 New York and ECB14:15/14:45 Berlin, with DST. Other event timestamps received sanity checks, not exhaustive official reconciliation.
coverage_caveats: The API request used min_importance=0, so this is a medium/high-importance calendar, not an exhaustive census of economic releases. Calendar ratings and title-specific coverage may change over time.

US S&P final manufacturing/services/composite PMI appear only 5 times per series over this two-year window. Eurozone final CPI only 5; Germany final CPI 4 per series; EU/DE/FR final PMI also sparse. Their absence for other months does not mean no release occurred.

US CPI package is 23 timestamps (not 24). The source includes November 2025 CPI on 2025-12-18, but no October 2025 reference-period CPI observation. Do not manufacture or interpolate a missing release.

US employment report has 24 NFP rows but only 23 release timestamps: October and November 2025 reference months share 2025-12-16 13:30 UTC. Participation/unemployment rows are fewer than NFP. Count the combined date once.

US PCE package has 24 reference-period releases but only 23 distinct timestamps because October and November 2025 observations share 2026-01-22 15:00 UTC. No Core PCE YoY row is present in this filtered source; Core PCE MoM exists throughout.

US GDP id386239 is a stale canceled October 30, 2025 advance-release schedule despite actual4.3. Exclude it. Official BEA verifies December 23, 2025 initial GDP release (GDP and deflator ids387585/387579), assigned to us_gdp_advance with stage initial_shutdown_delay. This releases replaces the advance and second estimates; the January 22, 2026 updated estimate replaces the final estimate.

ECB staff projection rows are listed at a separate later timestamp than the press conference (four rows only). They remain a separate category and are not silently reassigned to the rate-decision timestamp.

Speeches and multi-day conferences have heterogeneous agendas; scheduled time may differ from market-moving remarks. Auctions, energy inventories, political events and other meetings are retained in distinct non-core categories.

us_employment_report.result: All 12 distinct raw release timestamps match official dates. October and November 2025 establishment-survey data were published together December 16; no separate October news release. February 2026 delay is preserved.

us_cpi.result: All 12 distinct raw release timestamps match official dates. October 2025 reference-month CPI release was canceled. November CPI released December 18; missing MoM actuals reflect missing October data. February 2026 delay is preserved.

us_pce.result: All 11 distinct raw release timestamps match official dates. Combined October/November 2025 data are one January 22 observation. No stale October31/November26/December19 PCE placeholders occur in this raw calendar.

us_gdp.result: 11 valid release timestamps. Exclude stale canceled October30 row386239. December23 initial GDP belongs with advance/initial releases; January22 updated GDP belongs with final/revised releases.
